name: Website Design & Development
tagline: Professional, mobile-friendly websites built to win customers — and optimized to actually get found on Google.

hero.headline: Get a Website That Builds Trust, Loads Fast, and Wins More Customers
hero.subhead: A modern, SEO-ready website designed and built around your business — from a first landing page to a full redesign.

description: Your website is often the first impression customers have of your business. I design and build fast, mobile-friendly websites — landing pages, business sites, portfolios, blogs, and e-commerce — then optimize them so people can actually find you on Google. Everything is handled end-to-end: design, AI-assisted copywriting, on-page SEO, and deployment.
problems: An outdated or slow website is turning visitors away before they contact you
You don't have a website yet and are relying entirely on social media or word of mouth
Your site looks fine but doesn't rank on Google, so nobody finds it
You need a redesign but don't know where to start
deliverables: Live website on your own domain
Landing pages, business sites, portfolios, blogs, or e-commerce — built to your goal
On-page SEO: meta tags, headings, sitemap, Search Console setup
Source code (GitHub repository) and admin access
Basic SEO audit report and keyword research
Contact forms, Google Maps integration, social links
Training video for making your own content updates
features: Website redesigns and migrations from existing platforms
Fast, modern stack built for strong Core Web Vitals
Competitor analysis and keyword research baked into the build
Membership and e-commerce functionality when needed

process.detail: A short session to map your pages, goals, and content needs.
Mobile-first design paired with AI-assisted, brand-matched copywriting.
Development on a fast, modern stack with SEO fundamentals built in from day one.
One round of revisions to fine-tune before launch.
Deployment to your domain, plus a training video so you can make basic updates yourself.

faqs.question: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.answer: Not at all. I handle everything technical — you provide content and feedback, and I deliver a ready-to-use, SEO-ready website.

faqs.question: How long does a website take?
faqs.answer: Most business websites launch in 5–7 business days after I receive your content. Larger e-commerce or membership sites take longer, scoped upfront.

faqs.question: Can you redesign or improve my existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes — I can redesign an existing site, migrate it to a faster platform, or run an SEO pass on it to improve rankings without a full rebuild.

faqs.question: Will my site actually rank on Google?
faqs.answer: I build in on-page SEO (meta tags, sitemap, Search Console) from the start and can run keyword research and a competitor audit. No agency can guarantee first-page rankings, but the foundation is done right.
